root_causes: The historical compatibility module retained a complete, independently executable candidate-selection implementation (query matching, hard exclusions, security screening, ranking, deduplication, conflict truncation, phase selection, and diagnosis conversion). It had no current caller, but its presence could be accidentally reactivated and silently diverge from the sole K1/K2 implementation.

The legacy prompt-shaped packet exposed a source filesystem locator and caller-supplied K1 principles. It also exposed several selected metadata fields that were not included in the service-level prompt-injection scan, allowing an instruction-shaped legacy-only field or catalog identifier to bypass the canonical prompt boundary.
The compatibility snapshot alias is required for historical read-only tests, but it must remain unambiguously non-canonical and be rejected by the current replay entry point.
repair: Removed every retired selection helper from knowledge_flow.py. The compatibility function now remains a thin archive adapter that delegates to services.knowledge_retriever.retrieve_legacy_compatibility; the service-owned _select_metadata remains the only code that can determine K1/K2 eligibility, ordering, budget use, conflict exposure, and quarantine.

Made the legacy director projection prompt-safe: local source paths are removed, a locally derived digest replaces the external source reference, and caller-supplied K1 principles remain archival packet data but are not emitted to a model payload.

Expanded the service-owned security screen to every remaining string that can appear in either canonical or compatibility prompt views, including catalog IDs and legacy-only metadata. Instruction-shaped content is quarantined before it can become selected output.

Added regression coverage proving retired selectors are absent, legacy prompt projections cannot expose a local path or caller text, legacy-only metadata and identifiers are quarantined, and a legacy archive cannot be accepted by the canonical replay method.

checks.name: unselected_knowledge_excluded

They consist of stale DDO artifact hashes, R0.2 state/evidence mismatch, guarded baseline input and knowledge-hash drift, and eight unavailable golden media paths rooted at C:\Users\JT\Downloads.
